_client_rules: Decisions confirmed by the client, applied by the pipeline rather than by hand:
A. A blank workbook cell means NO CHANGE. It never clears a tracker value.
B. A project absent from the workbook means NO UPDATE, not finished. Status
stays an administrator's job in the app, so tracker_only_decisions is empty
by policy and not merely because nothing was decided.
C. Total Approved Budget is taken from the sheet as it stands and never
re-derived from the three CAPP columns.
_approved_new: Only rows that first appear in THIS workbook. Phase III of the IHG PIP and
Tenaya Cottages are deliberately absent: both first appear in the 25 September
workbook and are created by that import, which runs first. Listing them here
as well makes the reconcile refuse - PARKS r13 would match the project 0925
just created, which is reported as a blocking contradiction rather than
Banners- Blades & Boards is likewise created by the 0925 run, and is absent
from this workbook. Rule B keeps it: no row means no update, not deleted.
